_comment: Screen interior of each workstation PC base, inclusive [x0, y0, x1, y1], placed by hand on a 20x grid of each sprite: the glass only, never the bezel or an inner border line. 'rounded' bases keep their four corner pixels (pc7's glass has rounded corners). Read by make_locked_screen.py and by test/js/screen-states.test.mjs, which fails a locked picture that changes any pixel outside its rectangle.
